_comment: CONF-11 Cloud Storage Indicator Strings — categorized for signature scanning across Burp XML traffic

categories.name: AWS S3
categories.description: Amazon S3 bucket references — URLs, hostnames, SDK headers, and ARN patterns

strings.note: S3 global endpoint
S3 static website hosting hostname fragment
Virtual-hosted-style S3 bucket URL fragment (bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com)
Catch-all AWS hostname suffix
AWS S3 / request-signing header prefix (x-amz-id-2, x-amz-request-id, x-amz-security-token, etc.)
S3 extended request ID header — confirms S3 response
S3 request ID header — confirms S3 response
Temporary STS credential token in request — indicates IAM role / assumed identity
SSE header — reveals encryption config; missing = unencrypted bucket
ACL header — public-read / public-read-write ACLs are high-risk
Bucket region disclosure header
URL-signed S3 request — legacy credential disclosure in URL
AWS Signature V4 presigned URL credential parameter
AWS Signature V4 presigned URL signature parameter
Presigned URL with STS token — temporary credential exposure
S3 ARN pattern in policy documents or responses
S3 ARN — bucket/object reference in IAM policies or SDK responses
S3 XML response root element — indicates bucket listing response (public bucket!)
S3 error XML — bucket name confirmed, may be takeover candidate
S3 XML error — bucket exists but is access-controlled; enumerate for misconfiguration
S3 ACL grant string — bucket or object readable by the internet
S3 ACL grant string — bucket or object writable by the internet
S3 URI scheme — in HTML/JS indicates direct SDK or CLI reference

categories.name: AWS Other Services
categories.description: Non-S3 AWS service indicators that may appear alongside cloud storage misconfigurations

strings.note: AWS CloudFront CDN — may be fronting an S3 origin
API Gateway endpoint — REST/HTTP API exposure
Lambda function ARN or invocation endpoint
Cognito User Pool endpoint — auth flow
STS endpoint — credential issuance
Secrets Manager API — sensitive if reachable from client
Systems Manager — parameter store access
DynamoDB — direct database access from client
RDS endpoint — database hostname in responses

categories.name: Azure Blob Storage
categories.description: Azure Blob Storage hostnames, headers, and SDK-specific strings

strings.note: Azure Blob Storage hostname — primary indicator
Azure Blob hostname fragment (account.blob.core.windows.net)
Azure service domain — broad catch-all
Azure Blob response header — BlockBlob / AppendBlob / PageBlob type disclosure
Azure Storage REST API version header — present in all Azure Storage responses
Azure Storage request correlation header — confirms Azure Storage response
Azure Blob lease status — may indicate blob is locked or in use
Azure SSE header — missing or false indicates unencrypted blob
Azure Blob access tier (Hot/Cool/Archive) disclosure
Azure Blob copy operation header — reveals internal data movement
Azure Blob content hash header
Azure SAS token in URL — may allow unauthenticated blob access if leaked
Azure SAS URL signature parameter — combined with se= and sp= indicates SAS token
Azure SAS token expiry parameter
Azure SAS token permissions parameter (r=read, w=write, d=delete)
Azure portal / management domain catch-all
Azure Storage account domain suffix
Azure Queue Storage endpoint — message queue access
Azure Table Storage endpoint — NoSQL table access
Azure Files endpoint — SMB-over-HTTPS file share
Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 endpoint
Azure Blob service properties XML response — may reveal CORS rules
Azure static website container name — public web hosting via Blob
Azure container public access level in XML responses

categories.name: Google Cloud Storage
categories.description: GCS bucket hostnames, headers, and API response strings

strings.note: GCS JSON/XML API endpoint — primary indicator
Virtual-hosted-style GCS bucket URL
Google API domain catch-all — covers GCS, Drive, etc.
Google Cloud request/response header prefix (x-goog-hash, x-goog-stored-content-encoding, etc.)
GCS object integrity hash header
GCS object generation number — versioning
GCS object metadata generation — versioning
GCS stored encoding header
GCS storage class (STANDARD/NEARLINE/COLDLINE/ARCHIVE) disclosure
GCP project ID disclosure in headers
GCS resumable upload ID — may leak in error pages
GCS URI scheme — indicates SDK/CLI reference in HTML/JS
GCS IAM member string — allUsers read/write = public bucket!
GCS IAM member — any authenticated Google account can access
GCS XML API bucket listing root element (same as S3 XML format)
Firebase Storage endpoint — often misconfigured for open access
Google App Engine domain — may host or proxy GCS

categories.name: Generic Cloud / Multi-Cloud
categories.description: Vendor-neutral cloud storage patterns that appear across providers or indicate cloud infrastructure broadly

strings.note: File download header — combined with cloud hostname suggests direct blob download
HTTP ETag header — S3 and GCS use MD5-based ETags for object versioning
CORS wildcard on a cloud storage response — allows any origin to read blobs
CORS header on storage endpoint — review allowed origins
Presigned URL keyword in responses/JS — temporary credential exposure
Shared Access Signature abbreviation in responses/JS
Generic bucket reference in URLs, HTML, JS (low-signal; context-dependent)
Cloudflare CDN path — often proxies cloud storage
CDN cache status header — may reveal origin cloud storage
Proxy chain header — can reveal AWS/Azure/GCP origin
